spanish: Y el séptimo la soltarás y la abandonarás, y comerán necesitados de tu pueblo, y su resto lo comerá el animal del campo; así harás a tu viña, a tu olivo.

findings.issue: Ordinal is feminine singular absolute; Spanish uses the masculine article and ordinal.
The construct is definite because the people-noun has a 2ms suffix; the bare plural leaves that definiteness unmarked.
lo only resumes the fronted remainder as object of the 3fs verb and has no separate token.

notes: Qal 2ms acts on a 3fs suffix; the needy eat and the beast eats their remainder; vineyard and olive stay separate, with no added conjunction.
